description: Image Description: A wooden bowl containing several bright yellow citrus fruits, likely lemons or small oranges, is placed on a smooth, light-colored surface. The bowl is dark brown with a polished finish and has a rounded, shallow shape with a slightly flared rim. The fruits are clustered together, with their textured, bumpy skins clearly visible, and each fruit has a small stem or nub at the top. The background is softly blurred, featuring what appears to be a window with faint geometric patterns
